did: Built and tested live in the browser pane by hand. The owner switched reward points on (2 points for every 100 taka, 100 points worth 10 taka, least 20). A buyer's two market orders were marked delivered; the buyer opened the wallet and turned 30 points into a token.

checks.text: The Wallet has a new Reward points card with the balance in large type, how points are earned and what they are worth, and the history of each purchase that earned points

Two delivered orders of 1,200 taka of goods earned 24 points each, delivery not counted; turning 30 points into a token made a token of 3 taka that shows in the buyer's tokens, and the balance went to 18
A cancelled, returned or not-received order takes its points back once, a return takes back the points for that money, and points already turned into a token stay spent; points never go below nothing
A buyer cannot turn in more points than they have, or fewer than the least; with the programme off there is no card; two taps cannot spend the same points twice (automatic tests)

notes: Built this round from the spec (chapter 27, the extras). Points are earned on shop memos and market orders; the token is the same Aqua Token that works in every section. The referral reward was built before. 10 new automatic tests.
